identification: Mixed decorative china and glass, 1 photo. (a) Resin or porcelain-look figure group of a lady and a barefoot youth holding flowers beside a Corinthian column and tree, on a brown timber plinth, modern Capodimonte-style decorative piece. (b) Standing porcelain figure of a young man in 18th-century dress (white coat with floral sprigs, green cape, orange breeches, holding a rust-coloured hat) on a round base, Dresden/Meissen-style copy, probably modern. (c) Cut-glass or crystal jug with a gold paper label. (d) Cut-glass lidded sugar bowl or jam pot with a small black and gold label on the lid. (e) Floral tea set in white, swirl-moulded (wavy rim) bone china with pink and yellow florals and gilt edge: 4 cups, about 5 saucers, about 4 side plates, 1 sugar bowl (about 14 pieces). Total about 20 pieces.
